collection.title: Honda Civic Hybrid 2006 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Honda Civic Hybrid 2006 to 2007 model requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 23" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm and come pre-fitted with the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
